description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'getMcpServersSection' that generates a textual report about connected MCP servers, including their tools, resources, and instructions for creating new servers. It imports external modules and references external classes and functions related to MCP server management.

methods.name: getMcpServersSection
methods.description: Generates a detailed string report about connected MCP servers, their tools, resources, and instructions for creating new servers, with options to include tool descriptions and enable server creation instructions.
